schema_note: No manifest-level schema: every entry names the component it is checked against, as '../openapi.json#/components/schemas/<Name>'. validate.py validates with the whole OpenAPI document as the root, so internal references resolve.
note: All values synthetic. PHI and leak guards: response-problem-echoes-input, response-validation-issue-with-message, response-problem-unknown-code, and (part 2) response-message-detail-with-payload, response-message-content-presigned-claim-check, request-message-search-identifier-attr. Proposed as OPENAPI_PHI_GUARDS (6) for tests/conformance. The readiness entry is the observability/v0 example itself, checked against ApiReadiness here too, so the two contracts cannot drift on the api case. The inline content example's payload is the 15 ASCII bytes TRIBUTARY-SYNTH, not a clinical message.
expectation_note: Pairs written 2026-10-05 (part 1) and 2026-10-06 (part 2, W3-1b) by the architect WITHOUT a run: predictions until validate.py measures them.

invalid.violates: a git origin names its commit and path
no force flag or any other unknown field: strict producers
rollback requires expected_current_version, so a double rollback fails instead of going two versions back
a problem never echoes the request (invariant 6; a URL can carry a token)
a validation issue is json_path plus keyword; the jsonschema message embeds the failing value
an undeploy publishes a tombstone, so version is null
published means committed to _tb.<env>.channels, and says when
problem codes are a closed list; a library exception name is not one
spec_sha256 is 64 lowercase hex, no prefix
replay targets only its source channel's raw: there is no target field (wave-3.md 2.6 H8)
operation_id is a canonical UUIDv7, the library's request id grammar
a search attribute named for a direct identifier is refused (identifier search is deferred, ADR-004 H3)
invalid.expectation_note: The 'not' keyword is the deny-list. If this reports 'pattern', the example fails on the name grammar and the deny-list is no longer tested

invalid.violates: since is required: with the channel it bounds the archive scan
message detail is metadata for every role; content is only on the audited operator/admin operation (ADR-009 D14)
a completed replay reports its counts
a claim-check locator is never a presigned URL (a stored, replayable credential)
